name: comp-326

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the dialog with email and password filled and every control visible.

tagline: Login dialog pairs email and password with a Google sign-in option.
summary: A trigger opens a compact dark sign-in dialog with a ring icon, email and password fields, a Remember me checkbox, a Forgot password link, a white Sign in button and Login with Google.
appearance: Closed, an outlined Sign in button. Open, a narrow dark rounded dialog with a ring icon, a bold Welcome back title and grey subtitle, two labelled inputs, a Remember me checkbox with an underlined Forgot password? link, a white Sign in, an Or divider and an outlined Login with Google.
behaviour: The trigger fades the dialog in, and Escape or the X closes it. Typing fills the fields and the checkbox ticks, but Sign in and Login with Google have no action.
demo_content: The filled example uses maya@northwind.dev; placeholders are hi@yourcompany.com and Enter your password.
use_when: Users should sign in without leaving the page they were on.
avoid_when: The form has no submit logic, so Sign in and Google do nothing as shipped.
customise: Labels, placeholders and both auth actions are fixed in the file; the component takes no props.
weight_why: One dialog with two inputs and a checkbox; no animation beyond the fade.

a11y.note: Fields and the checkbox have bound labels, but there is no show-password control and no error handling.

issues: Sign in and Login with Google have no handlers.
The password field cannot be revealed.
polish_why: Clean, symmetrical login dialog with bound labels; submit actions are inert.
